function: Deep-unfolded MIMO precoding network (DU-BCA-MM) at devices, computed at the server, for uplink feature transmission in edge inference; also a learned feature encoder (pp. 3, 10-11).
system: Uplink MIMO multiple access: K=1 device, Nt=8, Nr=8 (CIFAR-10); K=3 devices, Nt,k=4, Nr=8 (ModelNet10); Rician fading; no RIS; frequency band not stated (p. 11).
method: Deep unfolding precoder (vanilla DU-BCA, enhanced DU-BCA-MM, 6 layers) and ResNet18/VGG11 feature encoder; supervised decoupled pretraining with MCR2, then end-to-end fine-tuning (pp. 6-11).
data_channel: CIFAR-10 and ModelNet10 datasets; simulated Rician fading (kappa=1), path loss 32.6+36.7 lg d dB at 80 m, noise -80 dBm; no 3GPP model or measured channel (p. 11).
test_conditions: Default: same channel settings for training and testing; Table V: trained at one Rician factor, tested at kappa 0.1 to 10; Fig. 9: varying training SNR (p. 15).
baselines: Non-learned: BCA and BCA-MM algorithms, LMMSE precoder with LMMSE detector. Learned: black-box ResNet18 precoder, vanilla DU-BCA, E2E-trained encoder with LMMSE transceiver, E2E learning without pretraining (Table II, p. 12).
metrics: Classification (inference) accuracy, MCR2 objective value, training time per epoch, CPU execution latency (Figs. 5-9, Tables III-V; pp. 12-15).
complexity: Learnable parameters per layer (Table I, p. 12), training time per epoch (Table III, p. 13), CPU execution latency of precoders, 0.011 s for DU-BCA-MM (Table IV, p. 14).
q1_support: p. 11: "modeled by Rician fading" with path loss 32.6 + 36.7 lg d dB; a custom simulator. The paper names no 3GPP, CDL/TDL, DeepMIMO, COST 2100 or measured channel.
q2_support: p. 15: "the network is trained on a specific Rician factor and tested across varying Rician factors" (Table V, kappa 0.1 to 10, with an 11.75% drop in the worst case).
q3_support: p. 13: "The enhanced DU-BCA-MM precoder also outperforms the black-box NN" (ResNet18 precoder, learned); p. 13: "can finally outperform all these benchmarks" (BCA and BCA-MM algorithms, non-learned; Fig. 6(b) accuracy). LMMSE benchmark on p. 14.
q4_support: p. 14: "Table IV presents the execution times of different precoding schemes on ModelNet10" (DU-BCA-MM 0.011 s); learnable parameters per layer in Table I, p. 12.
q5_support: p. 11: "We conduct the classification task on the CIFAR-10 [22] and ModelNet10 [23] datasets"; these are public task datasets only, the channel is simulated, and no code or data link is given.
notes: Area 3 because the learned function that matches one of the seven areas is the deep-unfolded MIMO precoder (trained learnable parameters). It is an uplink device-side precoder computed at the server with a task-oriented MCR2 objective instead of rate, so the reviewer should confirm area 3 and not a function exclusion. The feature encoder and MAP classifier are task-level, not physical layer. q3 counts the black-box ResNet18 precoder as the learned baseline; vanilla DU-BCA is the authors' own stepping-stone variant and E2E learning without pretraining is a variant, so neither was counted.
